name: Ƙwarewar Kwamfuta ta Farko
objectives: Idan aka ba ku kwamfutar tebur ko laptop, faɗin sunayen manyan sassanta, kunna ta da shiga, ba tare da taimako ba, kuna faɗin allon gani, allon rubutu, linzami ko trackpad da maɓallin kunnawa
Ta amfani da linzami ko trackpad, nuna wuri, danna sau ɗaya, danna sau biyu, danna maɓallin dama da gungurawa, kuna yin kowanne daidai idan aka nema
Ta amfani da allon rubutu, rubuta jimla da manyan haruffa, tazara da alamomin rubutu, da gyara kurakurai, da babban harafi a farkon kowace jimla, kuma an gyara kowane kuskure da Backspace ko undo
A kwamfutar Windows ko Mac, buɗe manhaja da sunanta, canja girman tagarta ko ɓoye ta, dawo da ita da rufe ta, ba tare da taimako ba
Idan aka ba ku gajeren rubutu da za ku ajiye, yin folda, ajiye rubutun a ciki da suna mai sarari, da sake nemo shi, fayil ɗin yana cikin foldar da ta dace, kuma an sake buɗe shi daga baya

Idan kwamfuta tana buƙatar kulawa ko tana da matsala, saka sabuntawa (updates), sake kunnawa, kashe ta yadda ya dace da zaɓar wuri mai aminci don neman taimako, kuna amfani da menu don kashewa, kuma ba ku taɓa kiran lambar da ke cikin taga mai tasowa (pop-up) ba

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Sassan kwamfuta, da kunna ta
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Faɗin sunayen manyan sassan kwamfuta, kunna ta da shiga.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku kwamfutar tebur ko laptop, za ku iya faɗin sunayen manyan sassanta, kunna ta da shiga, ba tare da taimako ba, kuna faɗin allon gani, allon rubutu, linzami ko trackpad da maɓallin kunnawa.
Kwamfutar tebur tana da allon gani (monitor), allon rubutu (keyboard), linzami (mouse) da akwati ko allo da ke ɗauke da kwamfutar kanta. Laptop tana da duk waɗannan a guri ɗaya da ake buɗewa kamar littafi; a maimakon linzami tana da faffaɗan wurin taɓawa da ake kira trackpad.
Don kunna ta, ku danna maɓallin kunnawa sau ɗaya. Yawanci yana da da'ira da layi a samanta. A laptop sau da yawa yana saman allon rubutu a dama, ko a gefe. Ku jira allon ya farka.
Yawancin kwamfutoci sai su nemi ku shiga da kalmar sirri (password) ko PIN. Ku rubuta shi ku danna Enter. A kwamfutar da ake rabawa, kamar ta ɗakin karatu, ma'aikata za su faɗa muku yadda ake shiga.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku nemo maɓallin kunnawa (da'ira da layi a sama).
- Ku danna shi sau ɗaya ku sake shi.
- Ku jira allon shiga.
- Ku rubuta kalmar sirri ko PIN ɗinku ku danna Enter.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Monitor (allon gani): allon kwamfutar tebur.
- Laptop: kwamfutar da ake buɗewa, allon gani da allon rubutu a guri ɗaya.
- Trackpad: faffaɗan wurin taɓawa a laptop da ke aiki kamar linzami.
- Shiga (sign in): rubuta kalmar sirri ko PIN don kwamfutar ta gane cewa ku ne.
Gwada yanzu: Ku nuna allon gani, allon rubutu da linzami (ko trackpad) a kwamfutar da ke kusa da ku. Ku nemo maɓallin kunnawa, ku kunna kwamfutar ku shiga.
Yanzu za ku iya faɗin sunayen sassan kwamfuta, kunna ta da shiga.

check.why: Monitor shi ne allon da kuke ganin aikinku a kai.

check.q: Kuna son amfani da kwamfuta a ɗakin karatu kuma tana neman ku shiga. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku riƙe maɓallin kunnawa har ta mutu
Ku rubuta haruffa barkatai har ta buɗe
Ku tambayi ma'aikata yadda ake shiga
check.why: A kwamfutar da ake rabawa, ma'aikata za su faɗa muku yadda ake shiga.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Amfani da linzami ko trackpad
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Nuna wuri, danna sau ɗaya, danna sau biyu, danna maɓallin dama da gungurawa.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da linzami ko trackpad, za ku iya nuna wuri, danna sau ɗaya, danna sau biyu, danna maɓallin dama da gungurawa, kuna yin kowanne daidai idan aka nema.
Linzami yana motsa alamar nuni (pointer), wato ƙaramar kibiya a kan allo. Ku ɗora hannunku a kan linzamin ku zame shi a hankali a kan tebur; kibiyar za ta bi shi. Idan wuri ya ƙare muku, ku ɗaga linzamin ku mayar da shi tsakiya.
Danna (click): danna maɓallin hagu sau ɗaya don zaɓar wani abu. Danna sau biyu (double-click): danna maɓallin hagu sau biyu da sauri don buɗe wani abu, kamar folda. Danna maɓallin dama (right-click): danna maɓallin dama sau ɗaya don ganin ɗan gajeren menu na zaɓuɓɓuka. Gungurawa (scroll): juya ƙaramar dabaran da ke tsakanin maɓallan don motsa shafi sama ko ƙasa.
A trackpad na laptop, ku zame yatsa ɗaya don motsa kibiyar, ku taɓa ko danna sau ɗaya don dannawa, kuma ku zame yatsu biyu sama ko ƙasa don gungurawa. Don danna maɓallin dama, ku taɓa da yatsu biyu.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku zame linzamin don motsa kibiyar.
- Danna: ku danna maɓallin hagu sau ɗaya.
- Danna sau biyu: ku danna maɓallin hagu sau biyu da sauri.
- Maɓallin dama: ku danna maɓallin dama sau ɗaya don menu.
- Gungurawa: ku juya dabaran, ko ku zame yatsu biyu a trackpad.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Pointer (alamar nuni): ƙaramar kibiya a kan allo da ke motsi tare da linzami.
- Click (danna): danna maɓallin hagu na linzami sau ɗaya.
- Double-click (danna sau biyu): danna maɓallin hagu sau biyu da sauri don buɗe wani abu.
- Right-click (maɓallin dama): danna maɓallin dama don ganin menu na zaɓuɓɓuka.
- Scroll (gungurawa): motsa shafi sama ko ƙasa.
Gwada yanzu: Ku buɗe kowane shafin intanet ko takarda. Ku gungura ƙasa ku dawo sama. Ku danna maɓallin dama a wuri mara komai ku karanta menu ɗin, sannan ku danna maɓallin Esc don rufe shi. Ku danna wata kalma sau biyu don zaɓar ta.
Yanzu za ku iya nuna wuri, danna sau ɗaya, danna sau biyu, danna maɓallin dama da gungurawa da linzami ko trackpad.

options: Tana motsa shafi sama ko ƙasa
check.why: Juya dabaran linzami, ko zame yatsu biyu a trackpad, yana motsa shafin.

check.q: A trackpad na laptop, kuna son ganin ɗan gajeren menu na zaɓuɓɓuka. Me za ku yi?
check.why: A trackpad, taɓawa da yatsu biyu ita ce danna maɓallin dama.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Rubutu da allon rubutu
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Rubuta jimla da manyan haruffa, tazara da alamomin rubutu, da gyara kurakurai.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da allon rubutu, za ku iya rubuta jimla da manyan haruffa, tazara da alamomin rubutu, da gyara kurakurai, da babban harafi a farkon kowace jimla, kuma an gyara kowane kuskure da Backspace ko undo.
Allon rubutu yana da haruffa, lambobi da maɓallai na musamman. Doguwar sandar da ke ƙasa ita ce Space bar (maɓallin tazara). Enter (Return a Mac) yana fara sabon layi ko yana cewa "tafi". Backspace (Delete a Mac) yana goge harafin da ke hagun layin da ke ƙyaftawa, wanda ake kira cursor.
Don babban harafi ɗaya, ku riƙe Shift ku danna harafin. Caps Lock yana mayar da kowane harafi babba har sai kun sake danna shi. Shift kuma yana rubuta alamar da ke saman maɓalli, kamar ? ko !.
Gajerun hanyoyi (shortcuts) suna adana lokaci. A Windows ku yi amfani da Ctrl; a Mac ku yi amfani da Command. Ctrl+Z yana soke kuskure (undo), Ctrl+C yana kwafa, Ctrl+V yana liƙawa, Ctrl+S kuma yana ajiyewa.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku danna inda kuke son rubutu; cursor zai riƙa ƙyaftawa a can.
- Ku riƙe Shift ku danna harafi don babban harafi.
- Ku danna Space bar tsakanin kalmomi.
- Ku danna Backspace (Delete a Mac) don gyara kuskure.
- Ku danna Enter (Return a Mac) don sabon layi.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Cursor: layin da ke ƙyaftawa wanda ke nuna inda rubutunku zai shiga.
- Shift: maɓallin da kuke riƙewa don babban harafi ko alamar sama.
- Backspace: maɓallin da ke goge harafin da ke hagu (Delete a Mac).
- Shortcut (gajeriyar hanya): haɗin maɓallai da ke yin aiki da sauri, kamar Ctrl+S don ajiyewa.
Gwada yanzu: Ku buɗe akwatin bincike ko takarda mara rubutu ku rubuta: Sunana ___ kuma ina koyon kwamfuta! Ku yi amfani da babban harafi a farko, sannan ku goge kalma ɗaya da Backspace ku sake rubuta ta.
Yanzu za ku iya rubuta jimloli da manyan haruffa da alamomin rubutu, gyara kurakurai da amfani da gajerun hanyoyin da aka saba.

check.q: Me Ctrl+C yake yi a Windows?
check.why: Ctrl+C yana kwafa; Ctrl+V yana liƙawa.

check.q: Duk abin da kuke rubutawa yana fitowa da manyan haruffa. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku sake danna Caps Lock don kashe shi
Ku riƙe Shift don kowane harafi
check.why: Caps Lock yana mayar da kowane harafi babba har sai kun sake danna shi.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Manhajoji, fayiloli da kulawa

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Buɗe manhajoji da sarrafa tagogi
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Buɗe manhaja, canja girman tagarta da rufe ta.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: A kwamfutar Windows ko Mac, za ku iya buɗe manhaja da sunanta, canja girman tagarta ko ɓoye ta, dawo da ita da rufe ta, ba tare da taimako ba.
Manhajoji (apps ko programs) suna yin ayyuka: burauza don intanet, manhajar rubutu don rubutu, manhajar hotuna don hotuna. A Windows, ku danna maɓallin Start (tambarin Windows a ƙasan allo) ku rubuta sunan manhajar. A Mac, ku danna gilashin ƙara girma a saman dama (Spotlight), ku rubuta sunan ku danna Return.
Kowace manhaja tana buɗewa a cikin taga (window). A kusurwar sama akwai ƙananan maɓallai. A Windows, a saman dama: layi (minimize, ɓoye ta na ɗan lokaci), murabba'i (maximize, cika allo) da X (rufewa). A Mac, a saman hagu: ja (rufewa), rawaya (ɓoyewa) da kore (cikakken allo).
Manhajojin da aka ɓoye suna jira a taskbar (Windows, a ƙasa) ko a Dock (Mac). Ku danna alamar manhajar a can don dawo da ita.
Mataki-mataki:
- Windows: ku danna Start ku rubuta sunan manhajar. Mac: ku danna gilashin ƙara girma ku rubuta sunan.
- Ku danna Enter ko Return don buɗe ta.
- Ku yi amfani da maɓallin minimize don ɓoye ta.
- Ku danna alamarta a taskbar ko Dock don dawo da ita.
- Ku rufe ta da X (Windows) ko maɓallin ja (Mac).
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Manhaja (app / program): shirin kwamfuta da ke yin aiki, kamar rubutu ko shiga intanet.
- Taga (window): akwatin da manhaja ke buɗewa a ciki.
- Minimize (ɓoyewa): ɓoye taga na ɗan lokaci ba tare da rufe ta ba.
- Taskbar / Dock: jerin alamomin manhajoji a ƙasan allo (taskbar a Windows, Dock a Mac).
Gwada yanzu: Ku buɗe Notepad (Windows) ko TextEdit (Mac) ta hanyar rubuta sunanta a Start ko Spotlight. Ku ɓoye ta, ku dawo da ita daga taskbar ko Dock, sannan ku sa ta cika allo.
Yanzu za ku iya buɗe kowace manhaja da sunanta, kewaya tsakanin tagogi da rufe su.

check.q: A Windows, me maɓallin murabba'i da ke saman dama na taga yake yi?
options: Yana sa tagar ta cika allo
check.why: Murabba'i shi ne maximize; layi yana ɓoye tagar, X kuma yana rufe ta.

check.q: Kun ɓoye manhajar rubutunku kuma yanzu kuna son dawo da ita. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku danna alamarta a taskbar (Windows) ko Dock (Mac)
check.why: Manhajojin da aka ɓoye suna jira a taskbar ko Dock har sai kun danna su.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Ajiye fayiloli da nemo su a cikin folda
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Ajiye rubutu a cikin foldar da kuka yi da sake nemo shi.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku gajeren rubutu da za ku ajiye, za ku iya yin folda, ajiye rubutun a ciki da suna mai sarari, da sake nemo shi, fayil ɗin yana cikin foldar da ta dace, kuma an sake buɗe shi daga baya.
Fayil (file) abu ɗaya ne da aka ajiye: wasiƙa, hoto, jeri. Folda tana ɗauke da fayiloli, kamar aljihun tebur a cikin kabad na takardu. Foldar Documents wuri ne mai kyau don fayilolinku.
Don yin folda: a Windows ku buɗe File Explorer (alamar folda mai launin rawaya), ku danna Documents, sannan ku zaɓi New da Folder. A Mac ku buɗe Finder (alamar fuska mai launin shuɗi), ku danna Documents, sannan ku buɗe menu na File ku zaɓi New Folder. Ku rubuta suna ku danna Enter ko Return.
Don ajiyewa: ku danna Ctrl+S (Command+S a Mac). Akwati zai buɗe; ku zaɓi foldar, ku rubuta suna mai sarari kamar "Tambayoyi ga Dr Lee", ku danna Save. Don nemo fayil daga baya, ku buɗe File Explorer ko Finder ku duba cikin foldar, ko ku rubuta wani ɓangare na sunan a akwatin bincike.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku buɗe File Explorer (Windows) ko Finder (Mac).
- Ku je Documents ku yi sabuwar folda.
- A cikin manhajarku, ku danna Ctrl+S (Command+S a Mac).
- Ku zaɓi foldar, ku rubuta suna mai sarari, ku danna Save.
- Don nemo shi: ku buɗe foldar, ko ku bincika wani ɓangare na sunan.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Fayil (file): abu ɗaya da aka ajiye, kamar wasiƙa ko hoto.
- Folda (folder): wurin da ke ɗauke da fayiloli, kamar aljihun tebur.
- File Explorer / Finder: manhajar duba fayiloli da folda (Windows / Mac).
Gwada yanzu: Ku yi folda mai suna "Practice" a cikin Documents. Ku rubuta gajeren jeri a Notepad ko TextEdit, ku ajiye shi a Practice da suna "My First Note", ku rufe manhajar, sannan ku nemo fayil ɗin ku sake buɗe shi.
Yanzu za ku iya yin folda, ajiye fayiloli da sunaye masu sarari da sake nemo su.

options: Abu ɗaya da aka ajiye, kamar wasiƙa, hoto ko jeri
Aljihun tebur da ke ɗauke da folda
check.why: Fayil abu ɗaya ne da aka ajiye; folda tana ɗauke da fayiloli.

check.q: Kun gama rubutu kuma kuna son ku riƙe shi. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku rufe manhajar ba tare da ajiyewa ba
Ku danna Ctrl+S (Command+S a Mac), ku zaɓi foldar, ku rubuta suna mai sarari ku danna Save
check.why: Ajiyewa tana sa rubutun a cikin folda da suna don ku same shi daga baya.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Kula da lafiyar kwamfutarku
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 4
Manufa: Saka sabuntawa, sake kunnawa da kashewa yadda ya dace, da sanin inda za ku nemi taimako.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan kwamfuta tana buƙatar kulawa ko tana da matsala, za ku iya saka sabuntawa (updates), sake kunnawa, kashe ta yadda ya dace da zaɓar wuri mai aminci don neman taimako, kuna amfani da menu don kashewa, kuma ba ku taɓa kiran lambar da ke cikin taga mai tasowa (pop-up) ba.
Sabuntawa (updates) suna gyara matsaloli kuma suna toshe ramukan tsaro. A Windows, ku buɗe Settings ku zaɓi Windows Update. A Mac, ku buɗe System Settings ku zaɓi General, sannan Software Update. Ku saka sabuntawa idan aka nema, ku bar kwamfutar ta sake kunnawa.
Idan kwamfutar tana jinkiri ko wani abu ya daskare (ya tsaya cak), ku ajiye aikinku ku sake kunna ta. Hakan yana gyara matsaloli da yawa. Don kashewa a Windows: Start, sannan alamar wuta, sannan Shut down. A Mac: menu na Apple a saman hagu, sannan Shut Down. Kada ku cire ta daga wuta kawai ko ku riƙe maɓallin kunnawa sai dai idan ta tsaya cak gaba ɗaya.
Idan taga mai tasowa (pop-up) ta ce kwamfutarku tana da ƙwayar cuta (virus) kuma ta ba da lambar waya, kada ku kira; ku rufe ta. Ku nemi taimako daga wanda kuka amince da shi, zaman taimakon fasaha na ɗakin karatu, ko shagon da kuka sayi kwamfutar.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku duba sabuntawa: Windows Update (Windows) ko Software Update (Mac).
- Ku saka su ku bar kwamfutar ta sake kunnawa.
- Tana jinkiri ko ta daskare? Ku ajiye aiki ku sake kunnawa.
- Kashewa: Start, alamar wuta, Shut down (Windows) ko menu na Apple, Shut Down (Mac).
- Kuna buƙatar taimako? Wanda kuka amince da shi, taimakon fasaha na ɗakin karatu ko shagon.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Sabuntawa (update): gyara kyauta daga kamfanin da ya yi kwamfutar, da ke inganta tsaro da ayyuka.
- Sake kunnawa (restart): kashe kwamfutar da kunna ta a mataki ɗaya.
- Kashewa (shut down): kashe kwamfutar gaba ɗaya ta hanyar da ta dace.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- FTC: Yadda ake gane, gujewa da kai rahoton zambar taimakon fasaha (Turanci)
Gwada yanzu: Aikin ƙarshe: ku kunna ku shiga, ku yi foldar Practice, ku rubuta gajeren rubutu da manyan haruffa a Notepad ko TextEdit ku ajiye shi, ku rufe shi, ku nemo shi ku sake buɗe shi, ku duba sabuntawa, sannan ku kashe kwamfutar yadda ya dace.
Yanzu za ku iya amfani da kwamfuta daga farko zuwa ƙarshe: shiga, aiki, ajiyewa, nemo fayilolinku da kashewa lafiya.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Kunnawa da shiga Yana buƙatar taimako don kunna kwamfutar ko shiga. Yana kunna kwamfutar kuma yana shiga ba tare da taimako ba. Yana kuma faɗin sunayen manyan sassan kwamfutar. Folda da rubutun da aka ajiye Babu foldar Practice ko rubutun da aka ajiye, ko rubutun yana da suna kamar Untitled. Foldar Practice a cikin Documents tana ɗauke da rubutun, an ajiye shi da suna mai sarari. Yana sake nemo fayil ɗin ta akwatin bincike da kuma ta foldar. Rubuta rubutun Babu rubutun, ko jimloli ba su da manyan haruffa. Gajeren rubutu da babban harafi a farkon kowace jimla, kuma an gyara kurakurai. Yana kuma amfani da alamomi kamar ? ko ! daidai, kuma yana amfani da Ctrl+Z (Command+Z) don soke kuskure. Buɗewa da rufe manhajar Ba zai iya buɗe Notepad ko TextEdit ba, ko ba zai iya rufe ta ba. Yana buɗe manhajar da sunanta, yana rufe ta, sannan yana nemo fayil ɗin da aka ajiye ya buɗe shi. Yana kuma ɓoye tagar ya dawo da ita daga taskbar ko Dock. Kashe kwamfuta An cire kwamfutar daga wuta ko an riƙe maɓallin kunnawa. Yana kashe ta yadda ya dace daga menu na Start ko menu na Apple. Yana kuma duba sabuntawa kafin ya kashe ta. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku gyara wannan sashe ku sake gwadawa.

check.q: A ina ake samun sabuntawa a kwamfutar Windows?
options: A cikin Settings, ƙarƙashin Windows Update
check.why: Sabuntawar Windows suna cikin Settings, ƙarƙashin Windows Update.

check.q: Kun gama aikin yau a kwamfutar Windows. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku danna Start, sannan alamar wuta, sannan Shut down
Ku rufe murfin yayin da manhaja ke ajiyewa
check.why: Kashewa daga menu ita ce hanyar da ta dace; cire ta daga wuta na iya jawo matsaloli.
